Message.Name: Market State - Product Message
Message.Description: Indicates the trading state of the product on the Ring and includes the ring session.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: TimeofEvent
Field.Description: Time of event. The specification spells this field TimeofEvent, where every other message spells it TimeOfEvent; the name is carried as the specification gives it.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: Product code.

Field.Name: TradingState
Field.Description: Trading State.

Field.Name: RingSession
Field.Description: This identifies the ring trading session.

Message.Name: Market Data Order Message
Message.Description: Generated each time there is a new order price and when Ring prices are withdrawn or deleted. Prices can be withdrawn if they are no longer being quoted by traders in the Ring, and deleted if incorrectly entered.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time at which the transaction occurred.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument ID.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: RingSession
Field.Description: This identifies the Ring trading session. Space if not applicable.

Field.Name: CancellationReason
Field.Description: Indicates that the event relates to an order cancellation. Space if not applicable.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: Product code.

Field.Name: BuySell
Field.Description: Buy or Sell.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order, in implicit six decimal place format. Can be null for a strategy market data order originating from LMEsmart.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Order quantity. Can be null for a strategy market data order originating from LMEsmart.

Field.Name: RemainingRecords
Field.Description: Number of remaining records to be published. When the value of RemainingRecords equals RecordCount this is the last message.

Field.Name: RecordCount
Field.Description: The number of records in this message.

Field.Name: StrategyLegCount
Field.Description: Number of legs present.

Field.Name: Order Legs
Field.Description: The strategy legs carried by this message, counted by RecordCount.

Message.Name: Indicative Trade Price Message
Message.Description: Generated each time there is a trade price and when a price has been deleted.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time at which the transaction occurred.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument ID.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: RingSession
Field.Description: This identifies the ring trading session.

Field.Name: IndicativePriceType
Field.Description: Indicative trade price type.

Field.Name: IndicativeTradePrice
Field.Description: The price of the trade, in implicit six decimal place format.
